Kind of interesting:

People spend thousands on skincare but wear polyester that suffocates their skin.

Your clothes are your secondary skin.

Stop sabotaging your baseline.

Friendly reminder that a luxury tag does not equal luxury quality.

Most designers are selling you a logo, not a textile.

Check the seam and the fiber composition before you pull out your card.

How to know if you have a good wardrobe:

If you can’t wear it to a professional lunch and a dinner date simultaneously, it’s just costume jewelry for your body.

Complexity is the enemy of style.

Fun fact:

You don’t need to be trendy. Just be intentional and people will assume you have it all figured out.

Clarity is the ultimate status symbol.
